params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Cassiopeia}} increases the effectiveness of all {{sti|ms|{{as|Movement Speed}}}} bonuses by a percentage.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Cassiopeia''' increases the effectiveness of all {{as|movement speed}} bonuses by {{pplevel|5 to 36|key=%}}.

params.blurb:
{{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Cassiopeia}} blasts an area with {{tip|Poison}} after a brief delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} over time to enemies hit.
She gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} if she hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cassiopeia''' creates a blast at the target location that explodes after a {{fd|0.4}}-second delay. Enemies within the blast are {{tip|poison|poisoned}} for 3 seconds, taking {{as|magic damage}} every {{ap|3/7|round=3}} seconds over the duration.
params.leveling: {{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|65 to 205}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}}|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|65/7 to 205/7|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|75/7|round=2}}% AP)}}}}
params.description2: If ''Noxious Blast'' hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}, '''Cassiopeia''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over 3 seconds.
params.notes:
* ''Noxious Blast'' always uses [[quick cast]], regardless of player settings.
* The damage inflicted by ''Noxious Blast'' is calculated as follows: damage / 7 ticks rounded down to the nearest integer.
** For example: with {{as|0 '''bonus''' AP}} ''Noxious Blast'' inflicts 75 damages over 7 ticks of damage, so 75/7 (≈10.71) deals first of all 10 damage, then (2{{times}}75/7) {{minus}} 10 (≈11.43) deals in a second time 11 damages, then (3{{times}}75/7) {{minus}} 10 {{minus}} 11 (≈11.14) deals in a third time 11 damages, and so on.
* The damage displayed for ''Noxious Blast'' DOT ([[Damage_over_time]]) always remains constant and corresponds to the previously mentioned formula: damage / 7 ticks rounded down to the nearest integer. It's important not to confuse the consistent displayed damage with the actual damage, which is updated with each tick, see [[tick and updates]].
** With the same example as above, the damage displayed is always 10.
* Occasionally, ''Noxious Blast'' may not deal the displayed damage. This discrepancy occurs when the calculated damage falls between 0.5 and 1. In such cases, rounding to the nearest integer, specifically rounding up, creates a 1-point difference. It's important to note that the damage is rounded down to the nearest integer.
** For example: with a {{iis|Blasting Wand}}, ''Noxious Blast'' shows {{ap|75 + {{as|90% of 45}} = 115,5 magic damage}} so rounded to the nearest integer {{ap|116 magic damage}}, but really deals using the formula above {{ap|115 magic damage}}.
* {{bug}} When '''Cassiopeia''' has precisely {{as|20 '''bonus''' AP}} or {{as|40 '''bonus''' AP}}. In this scenario, ''Noxious Blast'' may inflict 1 less damage than intended. Importantly, this bug occurs independently of rounding considerations.
* {{pending for test}} Enemies within the blast of ''Noxious Blast'' are {{tip|poison|poisoned}} for something between {{fd|3.2}} and {{fd|3.3}} seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Cassiopeia}} spews several clouds of {{tip|Poison}} that linger, continually dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within. They are also {{tip|slow|slowed}} and {{tip|ground|grounded}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cassiopeia''' spews forth 7 bolts of venom in an arc at the target location, creating toxic clouds at the area for 5 seconds.
params.description2: Enemies within the clouds are {{tip|poison|poisoned}} to take {{as|magic damage}} every {{ap|5/19|round=3}} seconds and become {{tip|ground|grounded}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by an amount that decays over the area's duration.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage Per Second|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|40 to 80}}%}}
params.notes:
* ''Miasma's'' {{tip|slow}} and {{tip|ground}} debuffs are each marked as non-dispellable, so they are not removed by most {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}}. Each is however allowed to be removed by cleanses that '''also''' grant immunity to the debuff type, such as {{cai|Ragnarok|Olaf}}.
* If a target becomes {{tip|untargetable}} while affected by the {{tip|ground}}, the debuff will refresh to {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
* {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} will block the portion of ''Miasma'' it destroys.
* ''Miasma'' inflicts {{as|{{ap|5 to 10}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} per tick, and in fact because there is 19 ticks and not 20 ticks, the {{as|'''total''' magic damage}} is currently not {{as|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|magic damage}} but {{as|{{ap|95 to 190}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{fd|47.5}}% AP)}}.
** Sometimes ''Miasma'' randomly inflicts only 18 ticks of damage.{{bug}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Cassiopeia}} launches an attack at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}. If this attack kills the target, the {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} is refunded.
params.blurb2: Against a {{tip|Poison|poisoned}} target, the attack deals increased damage and {{tip|heal|heals}} her.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cassiopeia''' launches her fangs at the target enemy that deal {{pplevel|50 to 120|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}. If this kills the target, ''Twin Fang's'' {{as|{{sti|mana|mana cost}}}} is refunded.
params.description2: Against a {{tip|poison|poisoned}} target, ''Twin Fang'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|heals}} '''Cassiopeia'''. The heal is reduced by 75% against {{tip|minions}} and small and medium {{tip|monsters}}.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}|Total Enhanced Damage|{{pp|50 to 120}} (+ {{ap|20 to 120}}) {{as|(+ {{ap|45+20}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Heal|{{as|{{ap|10 to 16}}% AP}}|Reduced Heal|{{as|{{ap|10*0.25 to 16*0.25}}% AP}}}}
params.target range: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|700|BUG: Displayed range, 765, is slightly larger than the real range}}
params.notes:
* Upon reaching the target, ''Twin Fang'' will wait for an ongoing {{ai|Noxious Blast|Cassiopeia}} to explode before dealing its damage.
* ''Twin Fang's'' damage against poisoned targets:
** When maxed first: {{pplevel|50+20;54+20;58+45;62+45;66+70;71+70;75+95;79+95;83+120 to 120+120 for 10;120 + 50 + (120-50)/17*(18+x-1)}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}}.
** When maxed second: {{pplevel|50+20;54+20;58+20;62+20;66+20;71+20;75+20;79+45;83+45;87+70;91+70;95+95;99+120 to 120+120 for 6;120 + 50 + (120-50)/17*(18+x-1)}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}}.
** When maxed last: {{pplevel|50+20 to 99+20 for 13;104+45;108+70;112+70;116+95;120+120;120 + 50 + (120-50)/17*(18+x-1)}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}}.
* ''Twin Fang's'' cast indicator is incorrectly adding her own radius to the range like an {{tip|edge range}} ability, and is therefore slightly larger than the actual cast range ''Twin Fang'' can cast at.
* Using ''Twin Fang'' on an out-of-range target after completing a movement order causes '''Cassiopeia''' to move back to her original location after casting, if no other order is issued during the entire process.{{bug|2}}
** This may be a consequence of ''Twing Fang'' being a "Walk in range of the target" ability that does not interrupt movement commands.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
params.tips: * Because 700 {{tip|centered range}} is equal to [ 700{{minus}}65{{minus}}65 = 570 ] {{tip|edge range}} (where 65 is the typical champion [[size]]) which is close to her {{sti|basic attack range}} of 550 units, and because her movement orders are not interrupted when ''Twin Fang'' is cast, ''Twin Fang'' allows the player to continue [[kiting]] effectively and repeatedly.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Cassiopeia}} blasts in a cone, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|stun|stunning}} any that are facing her, while {{tip|slow|slowing}} any others with their back turned.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Cassiopeia''' blasts enemies in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies struck within and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 40% for 2 seconds. Enemies with their facing direction towards her are instead {{tip|stun|stunned}} for the same duration.
params.effect radius: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|850|950 but starts 100 units behind Cassiopeia. Because of this, range is slightly greater laterally}}
params.notes:
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* Regarding ''Petrifying Gaze'' applying the {{tip|stun}}, ''facing '''Cassiopeia''''' means facing the opposite general ''direction'' (angle) as her; this direction bisects an 180 degree arc of a radius through her and her enemy. In other words, effectively, she must be "looking" toward the enemy.
* '''Cassiopeia''' will turn to face the target direction over the cast time.
** ''Petrifying Gaze's'' target direction will change if '''Cassiopeia's''' facing direction changes during the cast time (i.e. through {{tip|airborne|knockbacks}}).
*** The visual effect will not follow changes in '''Cassiopeia's''' facing direction and may not portray ''Petrifying Gaze's'' target direction accurately.{{bug}}
* The facing direction of champions whose abilities/animations cause them to lock their facing or spin is always the direction they are moving in. For abilities that cause the champion to spin in place (e.g. {{ai|Death Lotus|Katarina}}, {{ai|Judgment|Garen}}) it will factor the direction they were facing on cast.
** {{cai|R|Lucian}} is an exception and his facing direction is actually considered to be the direction he is facing.
